title: Evidence-gated close: refuse closeout with zero evidence
description: Context: a 2h47m dabble-employee-app agent session made 300 CLI calls with 24 failures. Failure clusters: 117 read-only work show polls (~40% of all calls), 14 identical failed sync refresh retries, 6 vault init retries, 66 agent finish calls with only 2 standalone evidence records, 6 NOT_FOUND finish/release (ownership confusion), 1 CONFLICT claim, 2 POLICY_VIOLATION sprint closes. Design principle for this mission: every response (success or error) must carry enough state that the correct next action is derivable without another read, and the honest path (evidence, ownership, health) must be the path of least resistance. Problem: closures were thin on evidence; policy said attach evidence but nothing enforced it. Change: work close and agent finish --close refuse when the work item has zero evidence records, emitting the existing gate vocabulary (gate.verification.unsatisfied / requiredEvidenceKinds / minEvidenceCount in enforcement-gaps.ts) with a terminal-error payload naming the exact evidence add or finish flags to use. An explicit escape hatch (--force-summary style, consistent with existing force flags on work close) stays available with a recorded reason code. Prerequisite: task on auto-capturing git evidence at finish should land first so the honest path is zero-effort and this gate rarely fires. Where: close/finish handlers in apps/cli/src/commands.ts, gate logic in packages/engine/src/runtime.ts. Constraint: container kinds (sprint/milestone) are governed by child-closeout gates, not this evidence gate; scope this to leaf task/issue closes.
acceptanceCriteria: Closing a leaf task with zero evidence is refused with the gate code and exact remedial command
Force path requires a reason code and is recorded on the work item
Sprint and milestone closes are unaffected by this gate (covered by existing child-closeout gates)
